title: A Storm in the City
text:
Last night a strong storm hit the city. The wind was very fast, and many trees fell on the roads. The local news reported that about two hundred homes lost electricity. Firefighters worked until the early morning to clear the streets.

This morning the mayor visited the area and spoke to the press. He said that the electricity company would fix the power lines by the evening. He also asked people to stay at home if possible and to call the emergency number if they needed help.

questions.text: What hit the city last night?
What did the mayor say the electricity company would do by the evening?
Why did the mayor ask people to stay at home?
options: The roads and power were not safe
They wanted to watch the news
The shops were closed for a holiday

questions.text: What can the reader most likely conclude about last night?
options: It caused problems for many people
It was a calm and quiet night

vocabulary.definition: a very strong weather event with heavy wind and rain
people whose job is to put out fires and help in emergencies
a serious and sudden situation that needs quick action
the power that supplies light and energy to homes

paragraph_translations: Zeszłej nocy silna burza uderzyła w miasto. Wiatr wiał bardzo szybko i wiele drzew przewróciło się na drogi. Lokalne wiadomości poinformowały, że około dwustu domów straciło prąd. Strażacy pracowali do wczesnego ranka, aby oczyścić ulice.

Dziś rano burmistrz odwiedził ten teren i rozmawiał z prasą. Powiedział, że firma energetyczna naprawi linie energetyczne do wieczora. Poprosił też ludzi, aby zostali w domu, jeśli to możliwe, i dzwonili pod numer alarmowy, jeśli potrzebują pomocy.
